next_action: Start Step 8 with the two CLI criticals from REVIEW-cli-python.md (most surgical first). C-01: src/cli/wav_io.c spu94_cli_wav_load checks channels/sample_rate but never bitsPerSample — drwav silently down-converts 24-bit to 16-bit, which is the most likely shape Anthony will drop on the CLI. Add `if (dw.bitsPerSample != 16)` and `if (dw.translatedFormatTag != DR_WAVE_FORMAT_PCM)` gates with actionable error messages (the review report has the exact patch around lines 91-107). C-02: src/cli/main.c lines 203-216 compute tail_frames = (uint64_t)(tail_seconds * sample_rate + 0.5) with no upper bound on tail_seconds + no isfinite() check + no overflow guard on total_out * sizeof(int16_t). Cap tail_seconds at 3600.0 + isfinite() reject + SIZE_MAX/sizeof(int16_t) overflow guard. Each is its own atomic commit (lib + test together — wav_io test goes in tests/cli/, main.c test extends the existing CLI smoke). H-03 (destroy-then-reset c_void_p keep-alive leak in python/spu94/api.py) is the third sub-fix, separate commit. Step 8 is a multi-commit step — that's expected since it's the largest remaining stage.
